build_TransformerEncoderLayer: build a TransformerEncoderLayer with self-attention and feed-forward network using a fairseq config object
build_TransformerDecoderLayer: build a TransformerDecoderLayer with self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, and feed-forward network using a fairseq config
prune_fc_layer: prune the feed-forward network layers in a TransformerEncoderLayer by removing low-magnitude neurons
run_forward_encoder: run the forward pass of a TransformerEncoderLayer with input tensor and optional padding mask
run_forward_decoder: run the forward pass of a TransformerDecoderLayer with input, encoder output, and incremental state
